name: Angel's Lesson
source:
Main character is a skilled physician and the only son of the director of the hospital. But director has to resign due to poor reputation and clients leaving the hospital. Hospital sisters are eager to give protagonist special lessons for two weeks to restore their workplace together.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名医术高明的医生，也是医院院长的独子。然而，医院因声誉不佳、患者不断流失，院长不得不辞职。为了共同挽救工作场所，医院里的护士姐妹决定在两周内为主人公提供特别课程。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
